text: Ninigi's great-grandson, Prince Iwarebiko, grew up on Kyushu, far from the other islands.
spoken: Nee-nee-gee's great-grandson, Prince Ee-wah-reh-bee-ko, grew up on Kyoo-shoo, far from the other islands.
